brand_notes: SX series is Cambridge's entry-level speaker range (SX-50 $229, SX-60 $329 on US maker page). SX-60 maker-rated 8 Ω; Hi-Fi World measured ~6 Ω. Audio Advice lists an 'SX-60 V2' at $369/pair (mfr-cambridge-audio-sx-60). Aeromax 2 no longer on US range page. Minx Min 12 is a 78 mm cube satellite sold individually at $99.
takeaways: Only Tier B data: Hi-Fi World lab sheet, sensitivity 86.6 dB vs 89 claimed, smooth tweeter, crossover ~3 kHz, bass roll-off to 60 Hz with port to 30 Hz.
No Klippel/spinorama; LW deviation, f3, directivity unknown.
Critics consistently describe forward, lively, a bit edgy, boxy; bass views differ.
No individual user reports retrievable; no QC issues found.
Price/status: $329 maker and Amazon in stock; Audio Advice V2 at $369.
